text:
Maya R.: Quick heads-up — starting bring-up for a quantized variant of open-6b (q-open6b-v2). Goal: get this into Dedicated test pool + run full evals. Need promptset curation, dedupe pass, golden refresh, and labeler capacity. Two-week window. Who can help?
Samir: I can take the dedupe & fingerprinting pipeline. will run a dry dedupe on the 5k seed.
Luca: I can own golden audit and the eval harness. Assign me the golden checklist.
Anya: I'll coordinate labeler capacity and update L1 instructions (binary / severity tags). how big is the golden target?
Maya R.: Target golden = 600 examples (stratified: 40% QA, 30% instruction, 20% code, 10% dialogs). Keep 20% reserved as edgecases.
Samir: Plan for dedupe: normalize -> sha1(prompt) -> cluster near-duplicates by jaccard on tokens. quick normalizer snippet:
```
python -c "from norm import normalize; print(normalize('Some prompt text...'))"
# then: sha1sum normalized.txt > fingerprints.txt
```
Luca: For evals, we'll do pairwise A/B vs baseline open6b-fp16 and run win-rate + semantic-similarity metrics. Also check hallucination regressions with targeted probes.
Kai: Heads up, quant smoke on q-open6b-v2 showed an uptick in refusal rate on safety prompts in initial pass :eyes:. need to add safety probes to golden.
Maya R.: Good catch. Add 80 safety probes into the golden reserve and include refusal/incorrect_answer columns in label schema.
Anya: Labeler instructions: each example -> pass/fail, severity {low,medium,high}, notes. Use quick checklist: reproduce prompt, confirm expected behavior, attach model output. Will spin up 12 labeler slots for 3 days.
Samir: I'll produce a dedup summary CSV with cluster_id, size, rep_id. We'll preserve one exemplar per cluster and mark duplicates for archival. Expect ~18% duplication on the seed.
Luca: For golden audit I'll run spot checks (n=200) and a full automated regression check. If win-rate delta > 3% or semantic sim < 0.85, we block rollout.
deploy-bot: created ticket ML-9482: "q-open6b-v2 - curation + golden audit" assigned to Luca, Samir, Anya. ETA 10 business days.
Maya R.: Sync meeting tomorrow 11am PST to triage blockers. Add any preflight failures in the ticket.
Anya: I'll post final label schema and quick-start guide in the ticket by EOD.
Samir: Starting dedupe run now, will ping here with summary when done.
Luca: Will prep the eval harness + docker image (tag: q-open6b-v2-eval:2026-03-21).
Maya R.: Thanks — aim to have first smoke + golden pass by end of week. :thumbsup:
